message: I’m here and willing to help, but $60 dollar is far too low for a landing page...
For this task, unfortunately, that amount is the full budget available to us.

No

Designed for children, our product consists of disposable bibs packaged with a branded restaurant appearance and included with kids’ meals. Restaurants and fast-food chains are our customers, so the page needs to emphasize the value for families and explain how the product improves restaurant quality.
Understood. Please share the link to the existing website.

For you, I’ll create a sample, and you will like it.

Neither web hosting nor a domain is required for the landing page.

Although constructing the landing page is easy, it serves no purpose unless it is live online because customers cannot reach it. Without a domain and hosting, there is no link to share and ads cannot direct anyone to the page; it would be like constructing a shop and leaving its door permanently locked.
For another company, I already have an existing domain.

If we do not publish it, nobody will be able to reach it because there will be nothing available on the internet.
